# Visual documents

| File | What |
| --- | --- |
| `third-reading.html` | Typeset journal of the reading. Open in a browser. Print to PDF if you regenerate. |
| `third-reading.pdf` | A4 print of the same (6 pages). |
| `cover.svg` | Vector cover plate. |
| `share-card.jpg` | 1200×630 card. |

Regenerate the PDF (needs Playwright):

```sh
node print-pdf.mjs
```
